name: blob_to_unreal
summary: Take a morph.engine blob from the Loom card and ride it through 5 passes into Unreal Engine. Captures the Three.js canvas snapshot, generates motion via HunyuanVideo (image→video), extracts a pose stream from the video (MediaPipe Holistic remapped to Meta Body joints), and streams the joint Transforms over UDP into Unreal's LiveLink plugin. Result: the blob's morph stack becomes a live-driven character in UE5.

inputs.name: blob_snapshot_png
inputs.notes: Base64 PNG from the morph_engine.html canvas. Provided by the Loom 'Export → Unreal' button or by cc loom-snapshot.

inputs.name: card_crystal
inputs.notes: The morph.engine card's content-hash for provenance. Crystal-anchored on every pass.

inputs.name: subject_name
inputs.notes: LiveLink Subject name shown in UE5's Live Link panel.

passes.notes: Browser POSTs base64 PNG of the current canvas frame. Server writes to ~/.cc/blob_renders/<crystal_short>/snapshot.png.
Existing HunyuanVideo queue consumer; image-conditioning via i2v workflow template. Output .mp4 lands at <render_dir>/video.mp4.

Walks video frames, runs MediaPipe Holistic, remaps 33-point pose landmarks to Meta Body joints via mocap_frame.MEDIAPIPE_POSE_TO_META_BODY. Writes one MocapFrame JSON line per video frame to ~/.cc/blob_renders/<crystal_short>/pose.jsonl.

Each MocapFrame from pose.jsonl gets verify_alignment(); accumulates per-frame alignment_crystals into a single rolled-up animation_crystal. animation_registry.record_frame() for each, then mark the source verified once frame_count threshold met.

Streams MocapFrame.joints over UDP to Unreal Engine's LiveLink Free plugin (default port 11111). Subject_name appears in UE5's Live Link panel; drives Animation Blueprint via LiveLinkSubject node. Sends one LiveLinkFrameData message per video frame at the card's declared fps.

layer_stack.name: motion
layer_stack.notes: Animation track replaces or blends with the rig's idle motion.

comfyui.notes: Image-to-video conditioning workflow with hunyuan_video_t2v_720p_bf16 + ip_adapter for blob frame conditioning.

spriteforge.notes: Per-frame snapshot atlas for inspecting the motion video without playing it.

depends_on: Unreal Engine 5 with LiveLink Free plugin enabled

ue5_side: Plugins → Animation → Live Link Skeletal Animation → enable
Restart UE5; Window → Live Link panel
Click + Source → Message Bus Source → select 'MspcBlob' once cc starts streaming
network: UDP port 11111 must be reachable from the host running this pipeline to the UE5 machine.
Default 127.0.0.1 assumes UE5 runs on the same box. Override --unreal-host for remote.
